title: Comparison of lifted affine tensor-section Cech complexes with Amitsur complexes
statement: Let X be a scheme, F a quasi-coherent X-module, U an etale X-scheme, and (V_i to U) a finite affine etale Cech cover [new-etale-finite-affine-cech-basis]. Put A = Gamma(U, O_U) and M = Gamma(U, U.hom*F), using the tensor pullback [lem-pc-module-pullback-identity-composition]. There exist a commutative ring B and a ring homomorphism a from A to B for which B is a faithfully flat A-module, and an isomorphism between the Mathlib Cech complex of the restricted lifted tensor-section sheaf [def-sc-etale-qcoherent-module] and the Amitsur complex of B over A with coefficients in M [lem-pc-cech-exact], after forgetting scalars and applying ULift. The isomorphism is an isomorphism of complexes in every nonnegative degree; no exactness or vanishing is asserted.

source.place: Tags 03OZ and 03P2, affine-case proof: identification with (B/A) tensor M before applying exactness; https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/03P2 and https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/03OZ

proof.text: Construct W as the finite coproduct of the V_i and g as Sigma.desc of their maps to U. The covering sieve makes g surjective, source-locality makes it etale, and the finite coproduct is affine. The Mathlib affine flat-and-surjective criterion makes g.appTop faithfully flat. Set B=Γ(W,top) and a=g.appTop. These are explicit data constructions, not arbitrary witnesses from existence theorems.
Apply the finite coproduct Cech comparison to the lifted tensor-section sheaf and the canonical coprojections, whose factorization equations are Sigma.ι_desc.

Apply the singleton affine tensor Amitsur comparison to g and compose the complex isomorphisms. Pair the result with the faithfully flat ring map already proved. The construction includes empty covering families: surjectivity forces U empty and both comparison theorems include empty schemes.

theorem exists_etaleTensorSectionsSheaf_ulift_cech_amitsur_iso
    (X : Scheme.{u}) (F : X.Modules) [F.IsQuasicoherent]
    (U : X.Etale) (I : Type (u + 1)) (V : I → X.Etale) (f : ∀ i : I, V i ⟶ U)
    (hf : finiteAffineEtaleCechCover X U I V f) :
    ∃ (B : CommRingCat.{u}) (a : Γ(U.left, ⊤) →+* B),
      letI : Algebra Γ(U.left, ⊤) B := a.toAlgebra
      Module.FaithfullyFlat Γ(U.left, ⊤) B ∧
        Nonempty (((cechComplexFunctor fun i : I ↦ Over.mk (f i)).obj
          ((Over.forget U).op ⋙
            ((sheafCompose X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.uliftFunctor.{u + 1, u}).obj
              (Modules.etaleTensorSectionsSheaf F)).obj)) ≅
          (((forget₂ (ModuleCat.{u} Γ(U.left, ⊤)) AddCommGrpCat.{u}) ⋙
            AddCommGrpCat.uliftFunctor.{u + 1, u}).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℕ)).obj
              (Algebra.TensorProduct.amitsurComplex Γ(U.left, ⊤) B
                Γ((Modules.tensorPullback U.hom).obj F, ⊤)))
